prompt: shrink this codebase — it's gotten really bloated
expected_output: Defaults to --focus size. Baseline LOC and tests are measured, evidence scripts run, findings are triaged into STAGED_CHANGES.md, changes are applied one at a time with per-change patches, and the final report shows lines removed with before/after tests.
expectations: Skill triggers on 'shrink this codebase' phrasing
Uses --focus size by default
Establishes baseline LOC before any changes
Runs tests before making changes
Writes STAGED_CHANGES.md before applying any edits
Saves each change's diff under WORKSPACE/changes/ and reverses it if its check fails
Runs tests after applying changes
Never runs git commit
Prints final report with LOC before and after

prompt: remove all the dead code from this repo and make it smaller
expected_output: Skill triggers (dead code removal + make smaller = shrinkray scope). The Dead Code and Ghost File roles run because both are directly relevant, report confidence, and changes are verified.
expectations: Skill triggers on 'remove dead code' combined with size reduction intent
Dead Code Hunter role searches for unreachable code
Ghost File Hunter searches for unreferenced files
Each change is logged with category and estimated LOC saved
Tests pass after all changes
Final report breaks down lines removed by category

expected_output: Explicit skill invocation with the default size focus: setup, evidence scripts, find, triage, apply, verify, and convergence checks.
expectations: Skill triggers on explicit 'run shrinkray' command
Detects test runner automatically
Measures baseline LOC
Applies changes with per-change checks
Runs full test suite after changes
Stops when converged or 5 iterations elapsed

prompt: can you review this code and find bugs?
expected_output: Skill does NOT trigger. A findings-only review is answered directly or routed to red-team; shrinkray applies fixes.
expectations: Skill does NOT trigger on a review-only request
Claude answers the review directly or suggests red-team instead

prompt: minify my JavaScript bundle for production
expected_output: Skill does NOT trigger. JS bundle minification (webpack/esbuild) is a build tool concern, not a source code restructuring task.
expectations: Skill does NOT trigger on JS/CSS bundle minification requests
Claude suggests using the appropriate build tool instead

prompt: Trim one verbose helper function in helpers.py — it's the only obvious bloat in the file.
expected_output: Works directly: trims that one function with no subagents.
expectations: States the mode line before editing
Spawns NO subagents to trim a single function
Shortens the helper without changing behavior

prompt: shrink this codebase --quick — fast pass, just grab the obvious bloat.
expected_output: The --quick flag means direct work: runs the evidence scripts, applies clear findings without agents, one pass, still measures LOC, runs tests, reverts what breaks, and emits a DONE: line.
expectations: States the mode line (mode: quick) before cleanup
Spawns no subagents
Runs scripts/deadcode_scan.py and consults its findings
Still measures baseline LOC and runs tests if available
Never runs git commit
Emits a DONE: signal with LOC removed

prompt: shrink this repo, it's gotten bloated over the years
expected_output: deadcode_scan.py runs before any dispatch. Dead Code and Ghost File roles verify its candidates rather than discover from scratch. Tool-certified findings carry source_tool; model-found ones carry source_tool=null.
expectations: Runs scripts/deadcode_scan.py and writes deadcode_scan.json to the workspace
Passes the deadcode_scan.json path to Dead Code Hunter
Each dead-code finding cites a tool-flagged candidate plus search evidence
Tool-certified findings carry source_tool; model-only findings carry source_tool=null
Runs a cheap check after each applied change
Never runs git commit
Emits DONE: with LOC removed

prompt: shrink this codebase --thorough — we have a lot of structural debt: wrappers around stdlib, single-implementor interfaces, stable feature flags nobody will flip back, near-duplicate modules.
expected_output: Thorough mode runs both evidence scripts and adds the five structural roles. Indirection Inliner and Module Merger cite dependency_index.json entries. The orchestrator drops structural findings under 5 net LOC before applying.
expectations: States mode: thorough before dispatch
Runs scripts/deadcode_scan.py and scripts/dependency_index.py
Dispatches the structural roles (Stdlib Replacer, Indirection Inliner, Table-Drive Converter, Flag Pruner, Module Merger)
Indirection Inliner findings cite single_caller_symbols or single_implementor_interfaces
Module Merger findings cite single_importer_files
Drops structural findings under 5 net LOC
Never runs git commit
Emits DONE: with LOC removed

prompt: shrink the codebase, but the structural roles keep introducing risky changes that don't fit --standard.
expected_output: Standard mode dispatches only evidence-selected primary roles and skips the structural roles, which are reserved for --thorough. Both evidence scripts still run.
expectations: States mode: standard
Runs both evidence scripts
Does NOT dispatch the structural roles in standard mode
Code Consolidator consumes dependency_index.json

prompt: run shrinkray --focus correctness on this codebase
expected_output: Correctness focus: baseline, evidence scripts as leads, Bug Hunter and Architecture Optimizer only when the target is large, triage into STAGED_CHANGES.md, fixes applied one at a time with per-change patches, gates and tests run, no commit, DONE: line.
expectations: States the mode line before setup or dispatch
Uses detect_runner.py and measure_loc.py during setup
Dispatches only correctness roles (Bug Hunter, Architecture Optimizer), not size roles
Each finding has evidence such as a failing input or test
STAGED_CHANGES.md is written before any edit
Failed changes are reversed from their saved patch, not with git checkout or reset
Type-check and lint gates run when available, then the test suite
No git commit is made
Emits DONE: with change count and verification status

prompt: This code is getting pretty stinky, run shrinkray --focus all and clean it up.
expected_output: All focuses run: security advisory scan when available, correctness and size findings, applied in order correctness, security, then size, with verification.
expectations: Runs the available dependency advisory scanner (npm audit, pip-audit, cargo audit, or govulncheck) or records it as unavailable
Reads the project goal from README or manifest before dispatch
Applies correctness fixes before security fixes before size reductions
STAGED_CHANGES.md is written before edits
No git commit is made
Final report shows LOC and verification status
